# Story Format v1 canonical fixtures

These directories are committed canonical Story Format v1 bundles. Tests load the files exactly as stored and require decode → encode to reproduce the same bytes.

- `minimal/` — smallest valid representable authored bundle.
- `lantern_mystery/` — canonical semantic reference project.
- `incomplete_editor/` — intentionally unfinished but representable editor work.
- `structured_large/` — deterministic 100-event / 99-choice structured project.
- `migration_source_v1/` — genuine v1 baseline reserved as source material when a future Story Format version introduces the first production migration. It is not a fictional legacy format.
